name: Playkeeper Self-Hosted Game Server Manager
free_limit: Free AGPL-3.0 self-hosted dashboard for managing Minecraft Java servers, mods, players, backups and updates on your own Linux VPS; no software quota or expiration published.
watch_out: Requires an existing Linux VPS, game server compute, disk and bandwidth; these are not free. Early v0.4.2 release; some integrations and ARM environments are not yet tested on real infrastructure. AGPL-3.0 obligations apply to modified network deployments; review privileged installer before running.
